7701: Cortech Endurance Wall Mount Bunk
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-7701-endurance-wall-mount-bunk
Manufacturer pages: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/beds/endurance-wall-bunk/, https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/beds/endurance-wall-bunk-safety-rails/, https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/endurance-wall-bunk/endurance-wall-bunk-ladder/
Spec sheets: 7701, 7702 / 7703 safety rails, 7704 ladder, Rail installation 61.5”, Rail installation 42”, Ladder installation
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Endurance Wall Mount Bunk – 7701
Current H1: Cortech Endurance Wall Mount Bunk - One-Piece Rotationally Molded - Model 7701
Subtitle: One-Piece Molded Wall Bunk for Single or Double Bunking, with Optional Safety Rails and Ladder
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 7701 Endurance Wall Mount Bunk
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Endurance Wall Mount Bunk is a one-piece molded bed that bolts to the wall, keeping the floor clear in cells and patient rooms. Two bunks can be mounted one above the other for double bunking, and the bunk takes a standard 30”×75” mattress.
The bunk is rotationally molded from high impact “no break” polyethylene, with no steel or wood components. It has been cycle tested with a 250 lb load 70,000 times and static load tested at 2,000 lbs for 24 hours. Molded safety rails and a molded ladder are available on this page and bolt to the bunk with the hardware provided.
Material: One-piece rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene; no steel or wood components
Dimensions: 81”W×35”D×18”H
Weight: 150 lbs
Mattress: Designed for a 30”×75” mattress; a 4½” thick mattress is recommended
Load Testing: 250 lb load cycled 70,000 times; 2,000 lb static load for 24 hours
Double Bunking: Space-saving design for double bunk use
Mounting: Bolts to the wall through concealed pilot holes with hardware of your choice
Antimicrobial Testing: Tested to ISO 22196, showing a greater than 99% reduction in bacteria
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133 and UL 94 HB
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD Gold
Easy Cleaning: Sound dampening, easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain, and resistant to stains
Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: Lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
7701 – Wall Mount Bunk: 81”W×35”D×18”H, 150 lbs
7702 – Safety Rail, 61.5”: 61½”L×4”W×12”H, 14 lbs; smooth, curved edges for ligature resistance
7703 – Small Safety Rail, 42”: 42”L×4”W×12”H, 9 lbs; smooth, curved edges for ligature resistance
7704 – Wall Bunk Ladder: 15½”L×4½”W×55”H, 34 lbs; smooth, curved surfaces with no pass-throughs for ligature resistance
Installation and Options
Wall Mounting: Bolt the bunk to the wall through concealed pilot holes with hardware of your choice
Safety Rails and Ladder: Bolt to the Wall Bunk with the tamper-resistant hardware provided; see Cortech instructions
Ladder Spacing: For ladder use, mount the two bunks 39” to 44” apart
Step Option: Cortech also offers the Endurance All Purpose Shelf, which can be installed as a step to the upper bunk
[H2] Applications
The Endurance Wall Mount Bunk suits rooms where beds must be fixed to the wall and floor space is limited.
Typical applications include:
Cells and housing units in correctional facilities and jails
Patient rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Double-bunked rooms in detention centers and other secure facilities
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Endurance Series
The Cortech Endurance Series is a line of heavy-duty molded furniture for behavioral healthcare facilities, correctional institutions, and other intense use environments. Endurance products are made for durability, easy cleaning, and safety-conscious design.
The Endurance Series includes:
Beds and Bunks: Endurance beds, wall-mounted bunks, and EZ Bunk stackable temporary sleep surfaces
Seating: Benches, cubes, and the Endurance ‘In Sync’ Modular Series chairs
Tables and Desks: Molded and laminate-top tables, freestanding desks, and wall-mounted desks, including ADA models
Storage: Lockers, nightstands, open chests, and shelving
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (53 characters): Cortech Endurance Wall Mount Bunk - 7701 at Anchortex
Meta description (151 characters): Shop the Cortech Endurance Wall Mount Bunk. A one-piece molded bunk for a 30”×75” mattress, tested to 2,000 lbs, with optional safety rails and ladder.
Notes and Questions
Series section: this is the same "About Cortech Endurance Series" section as on the EZ Bunk page.
H1: I took out "One-Piece Rotationally Molded" and "Model."
Weight: the bunk is set to 150 lbs, which matches the Cortech spec sheet. The accessories are set to 18 lbs (7702), 12 lbs (7703), and 40 lbs (7704). The Cortech spec sheets say 14 lbs, 9 lbs, and 34 lbs, so I used those.
Warranty: your current page does not list a warranty. The Cortech spec sheets say lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects for the bunk, rails, and ladder, so I added it.
Colors: your current page lists 5 colors. The Cortech spec sheet lists 18, so I used the Cortech list.
Stain resistant: the Cortech bunk spec sheet says "Resistant to stains," so I kept this. I left out "Maintenance free," since Cortech does not say this.
Ladder dimensions: the Cortech ladder spec sheet gives 55H×15.5L×4.5W. I wrote it as 15½”L×4½”W×55”H, the same order as the rails.
Patent: the Cortech spec sheet lists U.S. Patent No. 12,582,237 (Wall Bunk with Safety Rail). I left it out of the description. Would you like it added?
GREENGUARD Gold: this comes from the Cortech web page. The spec sheet does not mention it.
Product images: the page has two images: a black wall bunk and the older color chart. Cortech now lists 18 colors. Would you like the chart replaced?
